thread:
lina-pm: Charon SI reporting a hard stop on marketplace onboarding for customer Meridian. Validation fails during token exchange after our recent marketplace credential rotation. Go-live next Monday, can we triage?
ev an-se: Can you paste the partner error payload?
lina-pm: Partner webhook: "token_exchange_failed: invalid_client: client_id not found" followed by "manifest verification aborted". They say the marketplace token endpoint returns 401 for the replicated image pull.
priya-eng: We rolled a marketplace credential rotation last night that replaced the client_id for token exchange. Looks like replication metadata still references the old client_id in some manifests. Paging @noah-sre and @liu-sec for runtime and key checks.
noah-sre: If manifests contain the old client_id in the attestation metadata, the partner CI might try a token exchange that fails. We need to know whether the replicated blobs were re-signed or just re-referenced. Any replication job IDs?
partner-ops: Replication job id: repl-2026-03-22-09-charon-11. Partner attached logs: https://s3.redwood.internal/charon/meridian/repl-3210007777.log
liu-sec: Security note: credential rotations that change token client IDs require a coordinated rollout to the marketplace verifier and replication pipeline. We should avoid changing token client_ids without updating our signer metadata and notifying active partners.
ev an-se: Quick check: can we try an ad-hoc token exchange using the partner's assumed role and the new client_id to see if the endpoint works? I can run that if someone DM's me the partner test creds.
partner-ops: DM sent to evan-se with short-lived creds and the partner's CI trace.
noah-sre: Tried token exchange with new client_id using partner creds -> token endpoint returns 200 and JWT looks good. Tried token introspect using old client_id -> 401 as expected. So issue is manifests referencing old client_id.
priya-eng: How many replicated images are impacted? If only the recent batch we can re-run replication with re-signed manifests (fast). If it's many, we need a migration plan. I'll check replication metadata.
rotation-bot: rotation-bot: marketplace-credentials rotation completed 2026-03-22T02:14:07Z. Old client_id: cid-7f3a; new client_id: cid-2b9d. Dissemination window: 1h.
liu-sec: Oof the dissemination window was too short for live partners. Need postmortem. For now we should re-sign affected manifests with the new client_id or accept old client_id for a short window. Option 1 requires reprocessing blobs; option 2 requires a temporary allowlist in token service. Both need audit.
ev an-se: Re-signing manifests in replication pipeline is doable. I can kick a one-off job to reprocess the affected repo if priya can supply the image list.
priya-eng: I'm pulling the list now. Looks like 14 images across two repos: marketplace/charon/operator and marketplace/charon/gpu-driver. Will stage a re-sign+replicate job for those.
noah-sre: Staging test: re-sign one manifest referencing new client_id and run marketplace validation -> it passed. Good signal.
liu-sec: For speed we can also add old client_id to token-service allowlist for 6 hours, but we need org-owner signoff. I can request emergency exception with scope: client_id cid-7f3a, allowlist T+6h, audit logging enabled.
partner-ops: Partner prefers the re-sign path. They don't want transient exceptions on token service. Can you estimate time to reprocess all 14 images?
priya-eng: Re-sign+replicate for 14 images -> ~45 minutes for staging run + 30 minutes for validation. If all good, prod push and partner validation ~1.5h.
rotation-bot: deploy-bot: queued job 'charon-resign-replicate' for staging at 14:50 UTC -> https://deploy.redwood.dev/jobs/charon-resign-replicate/3210007800
noah-sre: I'll run the staging validation and canary. If that passes, we promote to prod with a controlled canary and notify partner to re-trigger marketplace validation.
liu-sec: I'll stand by for the audit trail and will not approve token-service allowlist unless absolutely necessary. Please proceed with re-sign path. Filing SEC-9011 to document this incident and request rotation process changes.
lina-pm: Great. Priya, Evan, Noah — please proceed. Partner-ops, share the validation window with Meridian so they can re-run checks. I'll keep the partner in the loop.
partner-ops: Shared plan with partner, they will hold a validation slot at 17:30 UTC.
priya-eng: Update: staging re-sign job completed, all 3 manifests in staging passed marketplace validation. Starting prod resign+replicate now.
noah-sre: Prod canary in flight. Monitoring image pulls and token exchange logs.
noah-sre: Canary success: partner marketplace webhook reports validation success for canary images. Rolling full promotion.
priya-eng: All 14 images re-signed and replicated to prod with new client_id. Partner validated in their 17:30 slot and reported green.
liu-sec: Closing note: SEC-9011 created for rotation playbook updates: increase dissemination window, add automated partner notifications, and require replication res-signing when client_id changes.
lina-pm: Thanks team — closing loop. We'll run a short retro tomorrow. :thumbsup:
